item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures this afternoon range from sixty-one to sixty-five degrees under mostly cloudy to cloudy skies, with rain showers likely in most areas and a chance of showers farther south. Tonight, skies turn mostly cloudy to partly cloudy with lows between forty-eight and fifty-three degrees and only a slight chance of lingering showers early. Rainfall amounts today and tonight will generally be less than one tenth of an inch across the region.
